name: NYC Planimetric Database: Open Space (Other)
description:
This dataset is a sample of New York City's Planimetric Database covering "other" open spaces—recreation areas that fall outside standard park classifications, such as plazas, greenways, and similar public or semi-public spaces. Each of the 5,000 records includes a source identifier, feature and sub-feature codes that classify the space type, an optional name, a status field indicating whether the feature is new, updated, or unchanged, and geometric attributes giving the area and perimeter length of each space.

The data is well suited to mapping and analyzing how open space is distributed across the city, supporting land-use and parks planning, and calculating total open-space acreage. Because the records carry geometry-derived measurements and classification codes, they can be combined with other planimetric layers for GIS analysis, spatial queries, or public-facing maps. Most features are unnamed (labeled "NO NAME"), and the named entries are largely cemeteries, so the dataset is best used for spatial and quantitative analysis rather
